name: Tsuyokiss 3gakki
source:
A further retelling of Tsuyokiss and Tsuyokiss 2gakki, takes place a few months after Celeb has transferred to Leo's class (but before the game enters any routes).

Inori, Mana and Tonfaa routes are reverse-ported from Tsuyokiss 2gakki console editions.
translation:
本作再次改写《娇蛮之吻》与《娇蛮之吻2学期》的故事，时间点位于橘濑丽武转入对马雷奥班级数月后，但尚未进入任何角色路线之前。

大江山祈、浦贺真名与杨豆花的路线，是从《娇蛮之吻2学期》主机版反向移植而来。
